    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import seaborn as sns\n",
    "\n",
    "import nflreadpy as nfl\n",
    "\n",
    "from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression\n",
    "from sklearn.metrics import mean_absolute_error"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "e3b70cdc",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",

      "Loading 2025...\n",
      "Finished!\n",
      "Rows: 389358\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "seasons = list(range(2018, 2026))\n",
    "\n",
    "all_seasons = []\n",
    "\n",
    "for year in seasons:\n",
    "    print(f\"Loading {year}...\")\n",
    "    \n",
    "    season_data = nfl.load_pbp(year).to_pandas()\n",
    "    all_seasons.append(season_data)\n",
    "\n",
    "df = pd.concat(all_seasons, ignore_index=True)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Finished!\")\n",
    "print(\"Rows:\", len(df))"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "df = df[df[\"season_type\"] == \"REG\"].copy()\n",
    "\n",

   ]

   "source": [
    "love_epa = love_plays[\n",
    "    love_plays[\"epa\"].notna()\n",
    "].copy()\n",
    "\n",
    "epa_by_year = (\n",
    "    love_epa\n",
    "    .groupby(\"season\")\n",
    "    .agg(\n",
    "        total_epa=(\"epa\", \"sum\"),\n",
    "        plays=(\"epa\", \"count\")\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    .reset_index()\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "epa_by_year[\"epa_per_play\"] = (\n",
    "    epa_by_year[\"total_epa\"] /\n",
    "    epa_by_year[\"plays\"]\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "epa_by_year"
   ]
  },

   ],
   "source": [
    "love_pass = love_plays[\n",
    "    (love_plays[\"pass\"] == 1) &\n",
    "    (love_plays[\"epa\"].notna())\n",
    "].copy()\n",
    "\n",
    "pass_epa_by_year = (\n",
    "    love_pass\n",
    "    .groupby(\"season\")\n",
    "    .agg(\n",
    "        total_pass_epa=(\"epa\", \"sum\"),\n",
    "        pass_plays=(\"epa\", \"count\")\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    .reset_index()\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "pass_epa_by_year[\"pass_epa\"] = (\n",
    "    pass_epa_by_year[\"total_pass_epa\"] /\n",
    "    pass_epa_by_year[\"pass_plays\"]\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "pass_epa_by_year"
   ]
  },

  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 11,
   "id": "3af6eeea",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "love_any_a = (\n",
    "    love_plays\n",
    "    .groupby(\"season\")\n",
    "    .agg(\n",
    "        passing_yards=(\"passing_yards\", \"sum\"),\n",
    "        touchdowns=(\"pass_touchdown\", \"sum\"),\n",
    "        interceptions=(\"interception\", \"sum\"),\n",
    "        sacks=(\"sack\", \"sum\"),\n",
    "        attempts=(\"pass_attempt\", \"sum\")\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    .reset_index()\n",
    ")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 12,
   "id": "9edfdc9f",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "sack_yards = (\n",
    "    love_plays[love_plays[\"sack\"] == 1]\n",
    "    .groupby(\"season\")[\"yards_gained\"]\n",
    "    .sum()\n",
    "    .reset_index(name=\"sack_yards\")\n",
    ")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 13,
   "id": "14423396",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "love_any_a = pd.merge(\n",
    "    love_any_a,\n",
    "    sack_yards,\n",
    "    on=\"season\",\n",
    "    how=\"left\"\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "love_any_a[\"sack_yards\"] = love_any_a[\"sack_yards\"].fillna(0)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 14,
   "id": "0fe1b772",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "love_any_a[\"ANY_A\"] = (\n",
    "    love_any_a[\"passing_yards\"]\n",
    "    + (20 * love_any_a[\"touchdowns\"])\n",
    "    - (45 * love_any_a[\"interceptions\"])\n",
    "    + love_any_a[\"sack_yards\"]\n",
    ") / (\n",
    "    love_any_a[\"attempts\"]\n",
    "    + love_any_a[\"sacks\"]\n",
    ")"
   ]
  },

  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 27,
   "id": "861a1f8e",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "metrics = [\n",
    "    \"epa_per_play\",\n",
    "    \"pass_epa\",\n",
    "    \"qbr\",\n",
    "    \"ANY_A\"\n",
    "]\n",
    "\n",
    "love_scaled = love.copy()\n",
    "\n",
    "for metric in metrics:\n",
    "    love_scaled[metric] = (\n",
    "        love[metric] - love[metric].mean()\n",
    "    ) / love[metric].std()"
   ]
  },

  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 29,
   "id": "8c7ebcb3",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "def career_average(data, metric, season):\n",
    "    previous = data[data[\"season\"] < season]\n",
    "    return previous[metric].mean()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 30,
   "id": "132e9448",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "def recent_average(data, metric, season):\n",
    "    previous = data[data[\"season\"] < season]\n",
    "    previous = previous.sort_values(\"season\")\n",
    "    \n",
    "    return previous.tail(3)[metric].mean()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 31,
   "id": "7a839f36",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "def linear_trend(data, metric, season):\n",
    "    previous = data[data[\"season\"] < season]\n",
    "\n",
    "    X = previous[[\"season\"]]\n",
    "    y = previous[metric]\n",
    "\n",
    "    model = LinearRegression()\n",
    "    model.fit(X, y)\n",
    "\n",
    "    prediction = model.predict([[season]])\n",
    "\n",
    "    return prediction[0]"
   ]
  },

       "   season        metric     actual  career_average  recent_average  \\\n",

       "6    2025           qbr  72.700000       70.533333       64.200000   \n",

   ],
   "source": [
    "test_seasons = [2024, 2025]\n",
    "\n",
    "forecast_results = []\n",
    "\n",
    "for season in test_seasons:\n",
    "\n",
    "    previous_data = love[love[\"season\"] < season].copy()\n",
    "\n",
    "    for metric in metrics:\n",
    "\n",
    "        actual = love[\n",
    "            love[\"season\"] == season\n",
    "        ][metric].iloc[0]\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Career average\n",
    "        career_prediction = previous_data[metric].mean()\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Recent average\n",
    "        recent_data = previous_data.sort_values(\"season\").tail(2)\n",
    "        recent_prediction = recent_data[metric].mean()\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Linear trend\n",
    "        X = previous_data[[\"season\"]]\n",
    "        y = previous_data[metric]\n",
    "\n",
    "        model = LinearRegression()\n",
    "        model.fit(X, y)\n",
    "\n",
    "        trend_prediction = model.predict([[season]])[0]\n",
    "\n",
    "        forecast_results.append({\n",
    "            \"season\": season,\n",
    "            \"metric\": metric,\n",
    "            \"actual\": actual,\n",
    "            \"career_average\": career_prediction,\n",
    "            \"recent_average\": recent_prediction,\n",
    "            \"linear_trend\": trend_prediction\n",
    "        })\n",
    "\n",
    "forecast_results = pd.DataFrame(forecast_results)\n",
    "\n",
    "forecast_results"
   ]
  },

   ],
   "source": [
    "career_mae = (\n",
    "    forecast_results[\"actual\"]\n",
    "    - forecast_results[\"career_average\"]\n",
    ").abs().mean()\n",
    "\n",
    "recent_mae = (\n",
    "    forecast_results[\"actual\"]\n",
    "    - forecast_results[\"recent_average\"]\n",
    ").abs().mean()\n",
    "\n",
    "trend_mae = (\n",
    "    forecast_results[\"actual\"]\n",
    "    - forecast_results[\"linear_trend\"]\n",
    ").abs().mean()\n",
    "\n",
    "model_errors = pd.DataFrame({\n",
    "    \"Model\": [\n",
    "        \"Career Average\",\n",
    "        \"Recent 2-Year Average\",\n",
    "        \"Linear Trend\"\n",
    "    ],\n",
    "    \"MAE\": [\n",
    "        career_mae,\n",
    "        recent_mae,\n",
    "        trend_mae\n",
    "    ]\n",
    "})\n",
    "\n",
    "model_errors"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",

      "Best forecasting method: Career Average\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "best_model = model_errors.loc[\n",
    "    model_errors[\"MAE\"].idxmin(),\n",
    "    \"Model\"\n",
    "]\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Best forecasting method:\", best_model)"
   ]
